entities.title: Production
entities.summary: The samosa Worker at icelander.net/games/retro/samosa* (and the old /retro-games/samosa*), with its static game and the D1 database samosa-scores.
entities.purpose: The game players reach at icelander.net/games/retro/samosa/ and its public scores page.
entities.deployedBy: The Deploy workflow on every push to main that changes games/dictator outside its .dev folders (or anything under .github/ outside .github/.dev); by hand with Run workflow, choosing dictator or all; or `npm run deploy` with a Cloudflare token.
approvals: A pull request: main accepts nothing else.
A reviewer on the repository's production environment, if one is set.
entities.rollback: No rollback is recorded. The Deploy workflow deploys only from main, so going back means merging a revert, which deploys it. A database migration is not undone by this; migrations are written so the previous code keeps working (docs/database-migrations.md).
entities.details: The Worker's routes run ahead of the games hub's less specific icelander.net/games/*. workers_dev and preview_urls are off, so there is no other address. The database was created once by hand from worker/schema.sql; since then it changes only through worker/migrations/.
